name: DOGMA Klein samplers
plain: Six presets named for Klein base and distilled models, built from Ralston 2-stage steps, variable-step AB2, Heun corrector and direction limiters. REBUILD, BALANCED and DETAIL change where the expensive steps go. Gains and thresholds are constants in code.
math:
Ralston: c2=⅔, x₂=x+d·⅔h, D=¼d+¾d₂; x+=D·h. AB2: r=|h/h₋₁| clamp[¼,4]; D=(1+½r)d−½r·d₋₁. limit: D·min(1, R·rms(d)/rms(D)).
distilled_BALANCED: Ralston every step. basemodel_DETAIL: limited AB2 for progress<0.55, Ralston after. basemodel_BALANCED: AB2 predictor with Heun corrector on every 6th step and progress≥0.85. Others apply early gain from progress.
